title: pnpm lockfile: duplicate schemastery entry
summary: A single-file change to pnpm-lock.yaml that adds a second, byte-identical entry for @deepseek-ai/schemastery@3.18.4 in both the packages and snapshots sections of the lockfile. No source, manifest or dependency version changes: the resolved integrity hash and the dependency set (cosmokit 1.8.5, @standard-schema/spec 1.1.0) are the same as the entry already present. The only effect is on the lockfile itself, which now carries a duplicated key that the package manager must reconcile on the next install.
